title: House easing: CustomEase tokens as GSAP defaults
summary: Five curves (`house`, `out`, `in`, `in-out`, `write`) and a `xs / s / m / l / fade` duration ladder written once as CSS custom properties, read on boot into `CustomEase.create` and `gsap.defaults({ ease: 'house', duration: --dur-m })`, so an unannotated tween, a named tween and a CSS `transition` share one curve; stagger as a token passed explicitly; movement durations `0s` under reduced motion with the fade kept, static zeroes the fade
variants: CSS tokens read into CustomEase (single source in CSS)
JS token module written to CSS custom properties
CSS linear() mirror for curves cubic-bezier cannot hold
